Agent Documentation

Observability and Testing

An agent can call tools and continue a session. Observability helps explain why the agent selected a tool.

Use ActivitySource to create a trace, and read the tracing documentation before enabling production telemetry.

Testing a session

  • Keep agent instructions clear and test tool failures.
  • A session may contain multiple requests and responses.
var agent = new Agent();
await agent.RunAsync("hello");
